description: 茶水间、电梯口、午饭前的几分钟：能自然接话、轻松收尾，不把闲聊变成查户口。

targetChunks.note: 比 How are you 更具体，适合周中。
targetChunks.exampleEn: How's your week going so far?
targetChunks.exampleZh: 这周到目前为止怎么样？

targetChunks.en: Did you get up to anything fun over the weekend?
targetChunks.note: get up to = 做/参与，口语；比 What did you do 更轻松。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Did you get up to anything fun over the weekend?

targetChunks.en: I'm not really a morning person.
targetChunks.note: 自嘲式闲聊，容易引起共鸣；比 I hate mornings 温和。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I'm not really a morning person — I need two coffees to function.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我不太是早起型，得两杯咖啡才能运转。

targetChunks.en: Have you tried the new place downstairs?
targetChunks.note: 聊吃的/新店是最安全的办公室话题。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Have you tried the new place downstairs?

targetChunks.en: I've been meaning to ask — how's the new hire settling in?
targetChunks.zh: 我一直想问，新同事适应得怎么样？
targetChunks.note: have been meaning to ask = 一直想问，过渡自然。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I've been meaning to ask — how's the new hire settling in?
targetChunks.exampleZh: 我一直想问，新同事适应得怎么样？

targetChunks.note: be into = 喜欢/感兴趣；用听说开头，不显得打听隐私。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I heard you're into climbing. How did you get into it?
targetChunks.exampleZh: 听说你喜欢攀岩。怎么开始的？

targetChunks.note: 自然的反应词；比 It's funny 更口语。
targetChunks.exampleEn: That's hilarious — I can't believe he said that.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 太好笑了，我不敢相信他这么说。

targetChunks.en: Anyway, I'll let you get back to it.
targetChunks.note: 礼貌结束闲聊；比 I have to go 更体贴。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Anyway, I'll let you get back to it.

targetChunks.en: Let's grab lunch sometime this week.
targetChunks.note: grab lunch = 快速吃个午饭，比 have lunch 随意。
targetChunks.exampleEn: Let's grab lunch sometime this week.

targetChunks.en: I'll take a rain check on that.
targetChunks.note: rain check = 改日再约；轻松拒绝，不伤感情。
targetChunks.exampleEn: I'll take a rain check on that — I'm swamped today.
targetChunks.exampleZh: 今天我去不了，改天吧，我忙不过来。

targetChunks.note: 办公室随口告别，比 Goodbye 自然。

roleplay.promptZh: 在茶水间遇到同事，聊周末、新同事和午饭，几分钟后自然结束对话、回到工作。
roleplay.promptEn: Chat with a colleague at the coffee machine about the weekend, a new hire, and lunch, then wrap up naturally.

script.speaker: you
script.en: Not bad. I'm not really a morning person, though. How about you?
script.zh: 还行，不过我不太是早起型。你呢？

script.speaker: other
script.en: Same. Did you get up to anything fun over the weekend?
script.zh: 一样。周末有什么好玩的吗？

script.speaker: you
script.en: I tried that new place downstairs. Have you been?
script.zh: 我试了楼下新店。你去过吗？

script.speaker: other
script.en: Not yet. I've been meaning to ask — how's the new hire settling in?
script.zh: 还没。我一直想问，新同事适应得怎么样？

script.speaker: you
script.en: Pretty well. I heard you're into climbing — maybe we should grab lunch this week.
script.zh: 挺好的。听说你喜欢攀岩，这周要不要一起吃午饭？

script.speaker: other
script.en: I'll take a rain check on that — I'm swamped today.
script.zh: 今天我去不了，改天吧，我忙不过来。

script.speaker: you
script.en: No worries. Anyway, I'll let you get back to it. Catch you later.
script.zh: 没事。好了，不打扰你忙，回头见。
